summary: PECO Energy Company filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $750 million offering of First and Refunding Mortgage Bonds, 5.000% Series due 2031. The bonds are priced at 99.965% of par, with an underwriting discount of 0.600%, yielding proceeds of $745.24 million before expenses. The bonds mature on September 1, 2031, pay semi-annual interest, and are secured under the company's First and Refunding Mortgage. Joint book-running managers include BNP Paribas and J.P. Morgan. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
